citations.excerpt: Come up with as many reasons as you can for why someone might behave unethically in a software project. ... For each of the following systems, come up with a brief story that describes how a lapse of ethical consideration could cause harm... Then, present one of the answers in Q2 and Q3 to other groups and get their feedback.

recall.a: Slogans without stakeholders, harm, framework or code; confusing the two schools; treating codes as decoration rather than action-guiding.
recall.q: What makes an ethics answer score poorly?

sections.heading: How ethics marks are lost
bullets: Declaring an action 'unethical' without naming stakeholders or harm.
Summarising deontology/utilitarianism without applying either to the scenario.
Citing codes of conduct without saying what action they require.
Harm stories with no lapse identified and no preventive alternative.

summary: Ethics mark-losers: slogans instead of stakeholder-harm-framework-code-action structure.
title: Ethics: common exam mistakes
